Verdict: Caught. When the stale-prompt cleanup deleted questions that other prompts still use, the maintained recall test failed. The earlier answer, its choices and its grade were really lost.

Next proof action: none needed for this promise on the on-demand recall path. The existing assertion `keepsTheEarlierAnswerWithItsChoicesAndGrade` catches the fault. No repair is planned and the probe raises no new repair decision. Without being asked, this run also saw the batch-import path catch the same fault.

Story and revision: SEED-073#replace-stale-waiting-questions, plan .planning/slice-plans/114-replace-stale-waiting-questions/PLAN.md, revision 7f6db6337a2e6dd628bc734baeeceec5352c5b6a, in a separate clean scratch worktree detached at that revision.

Promise: "Preserve answered attempts... A question record survives while any prompt still references it." Example 3: "Earlier answers, their choices and grades, and the due time are still available."

Fault: in MemoryTrackerLifecycle.deleteStaleUnansweredRecallPrompts, the stale prompts' question ids were deleted after deleteRecallPrompts without a reference check (temporary McqRepository JPQL `DELETE FROM Mcq question WHERE question.id IN :questionIds`). fk_recall_prompt_mcq_cascade then removes every prompt sharing a deleted question. Only the stale-cleanup path was faulted.

Fixture: MemoryTrackerBatchImportControllerTestBase#prepareAStaleWaitingQueueAfterAnAcceptedEdit (an unanswered stale prompt shares the answered prompt's question); fixtures and assertions unchanged.

Checks examined: MemoryTrackerRecallStalePromptRetirementControllerTest (including nested WhenRecallGeneratesTheCurrentQuestion) and MemoryTrackerBatchStalePromptRetirementControllerTest.

Run observations: baseline 10/10 pass. With the fault 5/10 failed: recall keepsTheEarlierAnswerWithItsChoicesAndGrade (no history item with grade GOOD, choice 0 and original choices), retiresOnlyTheUnansweredUncontestedPromptsFromAnotherFocus (answered prompt id missing), retiresStalePromptsWhenRecallSelectsAWaitingCurrentQuestion; batch keepsTheEarlierAnswerAndItsGrade and retiresOnlyTheUnansweredUncontestedPromptsFromAnotherFocus. Independent temporary witness on the recall path printed answeredPromptExists=false sharedMcqExists=false with the fault, true true after restoring. Restoration: source restored, temporary test deleted, git status clean, focused command 10/10 again; scratch worktree removed.

Assertion that caught it: MemoryTrackerRecallStalePromptRetirementControllerTest$WhenRecallGeneratesTheCurrentQuestion#keepsTheEarlierAnswerWithItsChoicesAndGrade.

Cost: Test runtime (measured, Gradle wall clock): baseline 24 s, fault 23 s, restored checks 17 s and 17 s. Human effort: unavailable (no separate measure; no human input). Agent effort: unavailable (no token/turn measure visible). Invocation-to-report elapsed (measured): 280502 ms, 1795334115187 to 1795334395689 Unix epoch ms.
